description: Who this connection is signed in as and what it may still do today: whether it is connected, the email, usage against the daily limits, which jurisdictions have a corpus, the newest data dates and the workflows on offer. Use it to check sign-in or the remaining allowance before a long task. For the plan, its limits and the account's keys use avokata_account; for what the corpus holds per legal area use describe. It reads no legal text and changes nothing. Example arguments: {}.

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: whoami
title: Account and allowance
